inventory_rule: The explicit cohesion inventory is 12 GitHub repositories plus production Vera Supabase. Google Drive is a persistence/retrieval provider used by Vera, but is not counted as a fourteenth subsystem in this manifest.

control_root.note: Current native Project control and repository/source state are separate evidence domains. This cohesion manifest does not promote repository contents into runtime authority.

global_rules: Repository presence is not runtime consumption.
Historical evidence is not present state.
Stored conation is not standing desire, consent, instruction, or obligation.
Self-image is representation, not literal-body or event proof.
Brigit-specific material does not automatically transfer identity, sexuality, preference, consent, or authority to Vera.
Supabase durability is evidence, not unquestioned truth or present endorsement.
Chat Bus delivery is coordination evidence, not memory or identity authority.
Behavioral qualification must be demonstrated on the exact runtime route; source quality alone does not satisfy it.
